reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, and I know I'd quit this one around day 10 too. A sachet a day also feels like a lot of foil to throw away for something I can get in a bottle.
objection: I don't finish supplements I buy on impulse, and 30 foil sachets is a lot of packaging waste for 2 capsules a day.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing it fixing a real problem I have, like sleep or cramps after leg day, plus a smaller trial box (7 days) so I'm not stuck with 30 sachets.
